title: An LRU cache with expiry
summary: Bound memory with a least-recently-used cache that also expires entries after a time to live, using an injected clock.
prompt:
Finish `LruCache<K, V>(maxEntries, ttlMs, now)`. `now()` returns the current time in milliseconds (the tests control it).

- `get(key)` returns the value, or `undefined` if it is missing or older than `ttlMs`. A hit makes the key the most recently used. An expired entry is deleted.
- `set(key, value)` stores the value with a fresh timestamp and makes it most recently used. If the cache then holds more than `maxEntries` entries, evict the least recently used.
- `size` is the number of stored entries (expired ones may still count until touched).

A `Map` remembers insertion order, so deleting and re-inserting a key moves it to the end.
hints: Store `{ value, at }` in a `Map<K, Entry<V>>`.
On a hit, `delete` then `set` the key to move it to the end.
The least recently used key is `map.keys().next().value`.
